storyboard_arc_title: Isla Learns to Publish Puzzle Books

storyboard_arc.setup: The idea is exciting. The starting point is not obvious.
storyboard_arc.disruption: Puzzles, solutions, interiors, covers, rights, and file organisation all matter.
storyboard_arc.choice: Sapiver Press turns the blank start into a file-led workflow.
storyboard_arc.product_proof: Classic, Hyper, Diagonal. Easy, Medium, Hard.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Pick one variant, one difficulty, one style. Build from there.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Find the pack at Sapiver Press on Etsy.

variant_recap.line: Commercial-use Sudoku publishing workflow, not a daily puzzle-solving strip.
variant_recap.short_rule: Commercial-use Sudoku publishing workflow, not a daily puzzle-solving strip.

captions:
Could I make my own Sudoku book?
The idea is exciting. The starting point is not obvious.

It is more than one puzzle page.
Puzzles, solutions, interiors, covers, rights, and file organisation all matter.

This gives me a structure.
Sapiver Press turns the blank start into a file-led workflow.

900 puzzles. 900 solutions.
Classic, Hyper, Diagonal. Easy, Medium, Hard.

I do not need to build every grid from scratch.
Pick one variant, one difficulty, one style. Build from there.

Start with the files. Build the book from there.
Find the pack at Sapiver Press on Etsy.

prompt_lint.screen_contract_rule: Open usable screen means puzzle required; no-puzzle panel means no open blank laptop screen.

previous_day_used.story_note: Isla spends this entry at the train table by the window because she is travelling and using the journey as thinking time. The puzzle stays as a light thread inside the day.
